subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Graded reader 2: The Animal App
outcomes: I can remember the main events of The Animal App.
I can use comparative adverbs to compare animals.
I can say how apps help us learn about nature.

tf.s: Dana downloaded the Animal App on Friday.
tf.why: Yes, she downloaded it on Friday.

tf.s: Dana’s app tells her the names of birds.
tf.why: The app tells her about small animals.

tf.s: On Saturday, Dana looked after her little sister Laila.
A grasshopper is green with long legs.
tf.why: Its long legs help it jump.

tf.s: A bee flies faster than a bird.
tf.why: A bee flies more slowly than a bird.

tf.s: Laila sees a big spider in the hedge.
tf.why: It isn’t a spider; it’s a cat’s nose.

tf.s: A grasshopper can jump higher than a frog.
tf.why: The story says it jumps higher than a frog.

tf.s: Laila was looking at a small animal in the grass.
tf.why: Yes, she found a small animal in the grass.

tf.s: A bee is red and blue.
tf.why: A bee is yellow and black.

tf.s: A hedge is a kind of insect.
tf.why: A hedge is a line of small trees or bushes.

boxes.q: What is green with long legs?
boxes.why: The grasshopper is green with long legs.

boxes.q: What is yellow and black and can fly?
Complete: A grasshopper can jump ___ than a frog.
Complete: A bee flies more ___ than a bird.

boxes.why: Dana looked after her little sister Laila.

boxes.q: When did Dana look after Laila?

boxes.why: The grasshopper is a great jumper.

boxes.q: What does a fact file about an animal include?
o: its colour, size and what it can do
boxes.why: A fact file gives facts like colour, size, home and abilities.

hunt.q: A bee flies more slowly than a…
A grasshopper jumps higher than a…

mcq.q: What does Dana’s new app do?
o: It tells her the names of small animals.
It tells her the names of birds.
It takes photos of the sky.
mcq.why: The Animal App is about small animals.

mcq.q: Where was Laila looking at a small animal?
mcq.why: Laila was looking at a small animal in the grass.

mcq.q: Which of these words is a plant?
mcq.why: A flower is a plant; the others are small animals.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a comparative sentence from the story?
o: It can jump higher than a frog.

mcq.q: Which sentence about a cheetah is correct?
o: A cheetah runs faster than a dog.
A cheetah runs more fast than a dog.
A cheetah runs fastly than a dog.
A cheetah runs fast than a dog.

mcq.q: Which sentence about the bee is correct?
o: A bee flies more slowly than a bird.
A bee flies slowlier than a bird.
A bee flies more slow than a bird.
A bee flies slowly than a bird.

mcq.q: Which facts belong in a fact file about the grasshopper?
o: It’s green with long legs. It can jump higher than a frog.
It’s yellow and black. It can fly.
It lives in a hedge. It has a big nose.
It is a plant. It has petals.
mcq.why: These are the grasshopper’s facts from the story.

mcq.q: “Laila sees a big spider in the hedge.” Choose the best answer.
mcq.why: Read carefully: the thing in the hedge was a cat’s nose.

mcq.q: How can apps help us learn about nature?
o: They tell us the names of animals and plants and facts about them.
mcq.why: An app like Dana’s gives names and facts.

mcq.q: Why does the story use “higher than a frog”?
o: To compare the grasshopper with another animal
To tell us the frog’s colour
To say where the frog lives
To show the frog is a plant
mcq.why: Comparatives help us see how animals are different.
